findings.reason: The criterion couples a local projective-line bundle chart with two differently directed twists. A local commutative square and an ordered recovery sequence materially clarify that rho gives relative O(-1), whereas -rho must be applied before pushforward. The complete proof does not remove this explanatory value.

correction: Added a local P1-bundle square and the kernel recovery sequence M -> O_X(-rho) tensor M -> N. Enlarged font and arrow spacing after actual initial rendering inspection.

diagram_math_checks.objects_and_maps: For a Zariski open U in X_alpha admitting a product chart, X_U=p_alpha^{-1}(U). Phi_U:P1 x U -> X_U is an isomorphism. Both vertical maps have codomain U, namely pr_U and p_alpha restricted to X_U. The bottom map is id_U.
diagram_math_checks.relation: p_alpha composed with Phi_U = pr_U, so the square commutes.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Assigned F1; minimal-parabolic-bundle supplier proof 2.1 constructs the local product and projection. Partial-flag-twist-product supplier proof 2.1 constructs the torsor chart. The added prose explicitly restricts the product to U and does not assert a global product.

diagram_math_checks.objects_and_maps: Recovery arrows denote functor operations, not same-category module homomorphisms: a coherent D_kappa-module M on X is sent by tensoring with O_X(-rho) to a D_{kappa-rho}-module, then by p_{alpha*} to the partial-TDO module N on X_alpha.
diagram_math_checks.relation: In the kernel case O_X(-rho) tensor M is canonically p_alpha^dagger N, and p_{alpha*}p_alpha^dagger N = N.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Assigned Statement (2), proof 2.1 and 3.1; partial-flag-twist-product Statement defines the partial TDO with isotropy character kappa and p_alpha^dagger N as a D_{kappa-rho}-module. PBW-and-twist Statement and proof 4.1 give the parameter shift by -rho. No direct p_{alpha*}M=N arrow is drawn.

diagram_math_checks.relation: p_alpha^dagger N has relative factor O_P1, O_X(rho) has relative factor O_P1(-1), and O_X(-rho) has its inverse O_P1(1). Thus M has local factor O_P1(-1) exterior N and the recovery twist cancels that factor before pushing forward.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Assigned F1 and proof 2.1-3.1; partial-flag-twist-product Statement and proof 2.1-3.1; relative-P1-singular-kernel proof 3.2 and 5.1 identify the recovery and its natural gluing. The partial TDO cocycle governs the base action; no global trivialization is asserted.
